defs.def: feeling fear; frightened because you think that you might be hurt or suffer 害怕，畏惧（可能受伤害、受苦）

ex.s: I realised I was always afraid of wanting too much.
ex.t: 我意识到我总是害怕想要太多。

ex.s: I used to afraid of insects, but last Friday’s biology class make a big change in me.
ex.t: 我过去害怕昆虫，但上周五的生物课让我发生了很大的改变。

ex.s: Your sister is a good swimmer;surely you will be, too. ”What she refused to acknowledge, however, was that I was visibly afraid of water.
ex.t: 你姐姐游泳很好；你肯定也会的。然而，她不愿承认的是，我明显怕水。

ex.s: “I was afraid that kids from other schools would laugh at him,” he explained uncomfortably.
ex.t: “我怕其他学校的孩子会笑他，”他不安地解释道。

ex.s: If the Textalyzer bill becomes law, he said, "people are going to be more afraid to put their hands on the cell phone."
ex.t: 他说，如果Textalyzer法案成为法律，“人们会更不敢把手放在手机上。”

ex.s: "I was afraid that kids from other schools would laugh at him," he explained uncomfortably.
ex.t: “我怕其他学校的孩子会笑他，”他不安地解释道。

ex.s: What was Prof Stone's grandfather afraid of?
ex.t: 斯通教授的祖父害怕什么？

ex.s: What was Prof Stone's grandfather afraid of?
ex.t: 斯通教授的祖父害怕什么？

ex.s: Do not be afraid to ask your doctor any questions you have.
ex.src: 2020全国新高考II卷·Talking with your doctor
ex.t: 不要害怕向你的医生提出你的任何问题。

ex.s: I never knew anyone who’d grown up in Jackson without being afraid of Mrs Calloway, our librarian.
ex.t: 我从未见过哪个在杰克逊长大的人不怕我们的图书管理员卡洛韦太太。

ex.s: My mother was not afraid of Mrs Calloway She wished me to have my own library card to check out books for myself.
ex.t: 我妈妈不害怕Calloway太太她希望我有自己的借书证可以自己借书。

ex.s: “Painters, sculptors—they've all tried to make the best of this ordinary face, but I'm afraid there's not much hope.
ex.t: “画家、雕塑家——他们都试图把这张普通的脸塑造到最好，但我怕希望不大。”

ex.s: Too much praise can backfire and, when given in a way that's insincere, make kids afraid to try new things or take a risk for fear of not being able to stay on top where their parents' praise has put them.
ex.t: 过多的表扬可能适得其反，而且当表扬以不真诚的方式给出时，会让孩子害怕尝试新事物或冒险，担心无法保持在父母表扬把他们放到的那个顶端位置。

ex.s: I was afraid that to speak in front of a larger group of people.
ex.t: 我害怕在更多人面前讲话。

ex.s: I'm afraid I won't be able to meet you this time, but you'll always be my dear friend.
ex.t: 恐怕这次我没法见你了，但你永远是我亲爱的朋友。

ex.s: Some people stopped swimming in the sea, afraid of the horrible creature from the film.
ex.t: 有些人不敢在海里游泳了，害怕电影里那个恐怖的生物。

ex.s: Only around six people are killed by sharks every year.Fortunately, not everyone who watched the film Jaws became afraid of sharks - some became interested in understanding them.
ex.t: 每年只有约六人被鲨鱼杀死。幸运的是，并非每个看了《大白鲨》的人都会害怕鲨鱼——有些人反而对了解它们产生了兴趣。

ex.s: You’re right,… I'm afraid… Well,… Student B You are a customer.
ex.t: 你说得对，……恐怕……嗯，…… 学生B 你是一位顾客。

ex.s: I’m afraid that I have to disagree.
ex.t: 恐怕我不得不反对。

defs.def: worried about what might happen 担心（会发生某事）

ex.s: From David Waters To Kay Silverman Subject Back to nature Hi Kay, We’re having an amazing time here in South Africa.
ex.t: 发件人大卫·沃特斯 收件人凯·西尔弗曼 主题 回归自然 嗨凯，我们在南非玩得特别棒。

ex.s: Freedom Day is held every year on 27 April to celebrate South Africa’s first fully-participated elections in 1994, in which everyone was allowed to vote regardless of skin colour.
ex.t: 每年4月27日是自由日，庆祝南非1994年首次全民参与的选举，在这次选举中，无论肤色如何，每个人都被允许投票。

ex.s: It has raised over ￡2 million for gorilla conservation and poverty reduction projects in Central Africa ·The Gorilla Organization works on gorilla conservation projects in Rwanda, Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo.
ex.t: 它为中非的大猩猩保护和扶贫项目筹集了超过200万英镑·大猩猩组织在中非的卢旺达、乌干达和刚果民主共和国开展大猩猩保护项目。

ex.s: Its field staff in Africa oversee a range of grassroots conservation projects, all of them aimed at addressing the key threats facing gorillas today.
ex.t: 其驻非洲的实地工作人员监管一系列基层保护项目，所有这些项目都旨在应对当今大猩猩面临的主要威胁。

ex.s: FRESHWATER PROBLEMS in Africa by 2025 * Freshwater shortage (less than 1,000 m3/capita/year) * Freshwater stress (1,000 to 1,700 m3/capita/year) * Globally, renewable internal freshwater resource per capita was around 6,000 m3 in 2014.
ex.t: 非洲2025年淡水问题 * 淡水短缺（人均每年少于1000立方米） * 淡水紧张（人均每年1000至1700立方米） * 全球范围内，2014年人均可再生内部淡水资源约6000立方米。
